target_customer: Retail host locations such as malls and venues that supply floor space, plus shoppers buying from self-serve kiosks
problem: Retail space owners want product sales revenue without staffing or inventory. Firsthand supplied the kiosk, the products and the software, and the host kept a share of monthly profit.
business_model: Revenue share kiosk retail, where Firsthand owns the hardware and inventory and splits profit with the host location

founders.name: Brian Yang
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists Brian Yang as Founder/CTO with no education or employers. No other founder is named on the YC page, though the team size is 2.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines custom retail hardware, payments, remote inventory software and field logistics, which is more than pure software for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Location contracts could help, but kiosk hardware and software were available to rivals and no source shows a proprietary advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Firsthand. Automated retail drew many startups in 2017, but the sources found were undated or later.

market_need_then: No dated source on demand for Firsthand was found. A general CB Insights note reports that first fundings to unmanned retail startups rose in 2017.

branding.domain_note: Used shopfirsthand.com with a shop prefix. The domain now redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found. A later unrelated AI company also uses the name Firsthand, which confuses search.

outcome_analysis: Firsthand was a two person Winter 2017 YC team building revenue share retail kiosks, and the YC directory now marks it inactive. Searches for a shutdown, acquisition or post-mortem found nothing, and the shopfirsthand.com domain is for sale, so the cause of the end is not public and no failure factors are assigned. The only funding record is a database entry for a $120K YC seed.
notes: Company site redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page, so the site is dead. The $120K seed rests on a single database (CB Insights). Seedtable lists a FirstHand with a seed of about $650K and a $15M round in December 2021, but it could not be tied to the kiosk company and a different company named Firsthand (an AI brand agent firm) raised seed and Series A money, so those figures are not recorded as rounds. Competitor list is empty because no source dated near the Winter 2017 batch named a rival; later sources such as Bodega coverage were undated or after the batch.
